profile.headline: Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Consultant | Public Sector & Enterprise | Plugins, PCF, Power Pages, Dataverse | Founder, Reyes Technology Consulting
profile.summary:
I specialize in building secure, enterprise-scale Microsoft Business Applications that help government agencies and highly regulated organizations modernize critical operations. My work spans Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, and DevSecOps, combining deep technical expertise with ownership of delivery, release governance, and platform reliability from development through production.

Throughout my career, I've delivered solutions supporting public sector, financial services, insurance, energy, and enterprise clients where performance, security, compliance, and scalability are non-negotiable. I enjoy translating business requirements into production-ready applications while ensuring deployments remain stable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term objectives. 

Some highlights of my experience include:
➠ Leading end-to-end ALM, CI/CD, and release governance across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production environments for large-scale Dynamics 365 and Power Platform implementations, including secured government cloud (GCC) environments.
➠ Engineering full-stack enterprise solutions using Dynamics 365, Dataverse, C# plugins, TypeScript and JavaScript web resources, Azure Functions, Azure Event Hubs, Power Automate, and Power Pages.
➠ Building high-volume Azure integration platforms for a major financial institution, processing hundreds of record updates per minute while improving monitoring, reliability, and operational visibility.
➠ Delivering statewide case management, investigation, complaint intake, and document automation capabilities for a state labor agency.
➠ Developing enterprise treasury automation that transformed Excel-driven financial processing into structured Dataverse workflows supporting calculations involving millions of dollars.
➠ Serving clients across the public sector, financial services, insurance, energy, and consumer sectors, from state agencies and large credit unions to asset managers and energy majors.

I enjoy solving difficult engineering problems, simplifying complex delivery pipelines, and building software platforms that remain reliable long after implementation. I deliver enterprise solutions by applying real software engineering practices across application design, integration, and lifecycle management, treating the platform as a development stack rather than a configuration tool. I own end-to-end delivery across environments, and I take ownership when systems cannot afford failure.

positions.title: Founder & Principal Consultant
positions.description:
• Founded Reyes Technology Consulting, an independent Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform practice with pro-code depth in C#, TypeScript, and Dataverse.
• Currently contracted to a Fortune 500 manufacturer, supporting enterprise Power Automate and Dataverse applications in production.
• Diagnose and resolve production defects across cloud flows, JavaScript web resources, and C# plugins, tracing each issue to root cause rather than patching symptoms.
• Bring six years of Microsoft Business Applications delivery across public sector (including GCC) and commercial clients.
positions.insights: Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
● Operated as a technical lead level engineer, becoming the go to resource for high priority engineering work while owning the delivery pipeline and conducting rigorous code reviews. 
● Delivered the core Power Platform and Dynamics 365 capabilities for a statewide Worker Protection case management and investigation system: model driven apps, a public facing Power Pages portal, canvas apps, and Power Automate across Labor Standards, Public Work, and Safety and Health. 
● Built an embedded Complaint Response canvas app, a multi pill document interface, and document generation logic spanning digital and paper complaint flows. 
● Developed custom C# Dataverse plugins (early bound) and TypeScript and JavaScript web resources to extend the platform beyond its out of the box limits, partnering with business analysts to translate program requirements into working features. 
● Owned end to end deployments across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production in a secured GCC environment: active layer cleanup before each deploy, removing conflicting hotfix and patch solutions, migrating reference data, repointing broken flow connection references to service accounts, and setting environment variables per environment in the pipeline YAML.
positions.insights: Microsoft Dataverse, Microsoft Power Automate and +7 skills

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
● Reduced batch processing completion time by roughly two thirds by developing a full stack React.js and Spring Boot MVC application with an optimized upload feature and Azure AD single sign on. 
● Practiced Scrum and ran CI/CD through a Jenkins pipeline.

projects.title: MINI-L Compiler
projects.description: A compiler for the Turing-complete language MINI-L. The compiler takes the source language and generates intermediate code to be interpreted and subsequently executed by the MIL interpreter. Provides robust error reporting when encountering any syntax or semantic errors.

projects.title: Mechanic Shop
projects.description: An application for a mechanic shop built in Java. The main focus of the application is the database backing the application. The application follows all of the constraints of the database schema. The DBMS used is PostgreSQL. I implemented an index when creating the database to drastically speed up the queries performed on the database.
